subject: IAM minisnap: role ownership roster + SAML assertion samples for SIG intake
messages:
From: Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@medtech-inc.com>
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — compact IAM artifact ask

Hi Dylan / Laura / Hannah,

We're kicking off the SIG/CAIQ intake for MedTech's vendor review and our security team has asked for a small, focused set of IAM artifacts so they can finish the first pass by EOD Wednesday. Instead of a full SOC2 pack, can you provide a minimal bundle that demonstrates the following areas?

- SAML assertion examples (successful login + an assertion showing edu/company attribute mapping)
- SCIM delta sample (1 user add, 1 user update)
- Role ownership mapping for the last 90 days (owner name + source of truth)
- A short note on RBAC enforcement and how least-privilege is verified during onboarding

If possible please keep the bundle compact (single-sheet role roster + text files for samples). Our reviewer prefers concise artifacts rather than the full export.

Deadline: Could you deliver by Wed Jun 16 2026 23:59 PT? If that's tight, let us know what subset you can make available earlier.

Thanks,
Aaron
Aaron Cole
Security Program Manager, MedTech Inc
aaron.cole@medtech-inc.com

---
Attachment: request-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@medtech-inc.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@medtech-inc.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — compact IAM artifact ask

Aaron — thanks for the clear list. We can do a "minisnap" bundle that targets exactly what you described so your reviewers can get unblocked. Plan: 

1) I'll assemble SAML assertion text samples (redacted PII) and a one-paragraph notes file that explains the assertion fields and attribute mappings.
2) Laura will produce a trimmed SCIM delta CSV (1 add / 1 update) and the role ownership sheet (single worksheet, owner, last change, source).
3) Hannah will write a 2–3 bullet assurance note on RBAC enforcement and least-privilege checks during provisioning.

We will attach the three files in one package and drop links to a Drive folder for any follow-ups. We expect to hit your deadline on Wed; if anything slips we'll push an interim package by Mon EOD.

Can you confirm the reviewer can accept redacted assertion samples (we will remove email addresses and session IDs)?

Thanks — Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0102

(To expedite, I am marking this as high-priority and looping Laura and Hannah for artifact prep.)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, sean.gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — compact IAM artifact ask

Got it. I'll put together the role ownership minisheet and the SCIM delta sample this morning. A couple quick notes: 

- Role ownership: we'll export the current role catalog and collapse it to the last owner change per role; the sheet will include role id, human-friendly name, owner (name + email), last_modified_ts, and authoritative source (console / infra-as-code).
- SCIM delta: we'll generate a slim CSV with three columns (op,type,user_identifier) for the reviewer; it will intentionally omit user PII and include only usernames/UUIDs.
- SAML: Dylan, I'll coordinate on the exact assertion fields we want redacted — we should keep NameID type and the edu/company attribute values to show mapping.

I'll attach the two files in an initial drop and then Dylan can merge with his assertion text.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Security Intake
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Attachments (pending): role-ownership-minisnap.xlsx, scim-delta-slim.csv

From: dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
To: Aaron Cole <aaron.cole@medtech-inc.com>, Sara Nguyen <sara.nguyen@medtech-inc.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — compact IAM artifact ask

Aaron / Sara — attaching the minisnap bundle for initial review. Contents: 

1) role-ownership-minisnap.xlsx — single-sheet roster (role_id, role_name, owner_name, owner_email, last_modified, source).
2) scim-delta-slim.csv — two example deltas (add, update) with non-sensitive identifiers.
3) saml-assertion-samples.txt — two redacted assertion examples plus a short note on attribute mappings and how we validate NameID/edu fields at assertion time.
4) short note: rbac-assurance.txt (inline below) — 3 bullets on enforcement and least-privilege checks.

Inline RBAC assurance (rfc):
- Provisioning pipeline enforces role templates tied to least-privilege defaults; elevated roles require an owner and a justification ticket that is tracked for 90-day recertification.
- Role assignment is gated by SCIM group sync and an authorization service that checks entitlement boundaries at token mint time; we log policy evaluation decisions for sampling during audits.
- Access reviews: owners receive quarterly recertification prompts; exceptions are recorded in the audit log and require manager sign-off.

Let us know if you want any fields expanded. If the reviewer needs the full assertion logs (with session IDs), we'll prepare a redaction plan and a secure transfer.

Drive link (read-only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbCdEF2ghIJkLMN0
HubSpot reference: 12345-67890

Best,
Dylan

---
Attachments: saml-assertion-samples.txt, scim-delta-slim.csv, role-ownership-minisnap.xlsx
